text.text_excerpt: Fun and delicious! I came here with a couple friends. We chose to sit outside which was an excellent choice. I recognized the location as it was a different restaurant before, and I like what they've done with it. The flamingo theme is cute but not too girly. There's a projector outside that shows on the tall brick wall of the building next door. Outside (and inside) there was plenty of seating and a bar. There were about four parties of 6-12 people seated outside and there was still plenty of room. It got a little chilly as the night went on, so an employee turned a couple of the heating stands they had throughout the patio area. They did just the trick and kept it comfortable. Parking: ...

There are so many reviews for this place I almost think it's pointless to add yet another, however I've had Flamingo A-Go-Go on my bucket list for a while but in all my stays in town I just hadn't been able to work it in. So much food, so little time when in Nola! I was in town over St Patty's weekend to see Hamilton. The city was packed and all hotels were booked up - it was a big weekend. I had initially made reservations for my party of 4 for another place for dinner Saturday evening before the show but as a group we ended up preferring somewhere more casual. By then, reservations for everywhere were none to be had and I didn't want to risk being late for the show by not having one, so...

omg. i never got so drunk/tipsy over bottomless mimosas before until now LOL. i came with my sorority sisters for a boozy brunch on sunday, had the entire middle high chair table to ourselves and enjoyed each other's company, went outside and enjoyed the outdoor decor and seating, and even played with the photobooth that they have set up in the corner next to the entrance. the service was great, the waitresses took our order by name and filled up our mimosas regularly (which is probably why i got so drunk so quick haha) but anyways, i really liked the food ( i only got the appetizer because i wanted to save room for lunch later ) but the fried chicken was delicious !! all the food options...
